Title: Loofah `allowed_uri?` does not detect `javascript:` URIs split by numeric character references without semicolons
Description: `Loofah::HTML5::Scrub.allowed_uri?` does not correctly reject `javascript:` or `vbscript:` URIs when the scheme is split by a numeric character reference that has no trailing semicolon. A browser decodes such references and resolves the URL to an executable `javascript:` scheme, while `allowed_uri?` reports it safe.
NotImpacted: All versions before 2.25.0, all versions starting from 2.25.2
